description: Search the Stack Gems catalog of reviewed developer tools. Matches name, tagline, verdict, Catch, subcategory and tags. Filters combine with AND. Returns verdict and the first sentence of the Catch for each hit.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "postgres backup" or "browser automation"

tag.description: Comma list of tags, all must match (see list_categories), e.g. "mcp,self-host"

name: search_gems
title: Search developer tools
